caption: The drawing features a rectangular patch of deep blue color centered on a plain, off-white background. Inside the blue rectangle, there are three stylized leaves arranged in a loose, upward-pointing cluster. The leaf on the left is a pale yellow color with a dark blue vein pattern, the leaf on the right is green with a similar dark blue vein, and the central leaf is light beige with thin lines in a dark blue shade. Smaller, branch-like fronds in beige and green are interspersed among the leaves. The overall area of illustration with leaves and fronds does not extend beyond the border of the blue rectangle, which has rough, textile-like edges, and the design is entirely contained within this central square. The majority of the paper remains empty, emphasizing the composition’s central placement. Near the lower edge of the blue rectangle and just beneath it, there is a small text or signature.
title: Detail of Skirt Design
